videos.script: Data at rest is data on a disk, in a database or in a backup. Encrypting it answers one question. What does somebody get if they walk away with the storage? {{title}} A stolen laptop with an encrypted disk gives them nothing, if the passphrase is good. {{disk}} The same encryption does nothing against somebody who logs in to the running laptop. The disk is unlocked then, for everybody who can use it. {{running}} Databases have the same split. Encrypting the database files protects the backups. Encrypting a column protects one value even from the people who run the database. {{column}} And everything depends on where the key lives. {{keys}} This lesson builds each layer in the lab and says which theft each one stops.
